opening.argument: The opportunity is presented through recruitment, hierarchical growth, and financial incentives rather than as neutral cryptocurrency commentary. The speaker foregrounds a credential built on “the biggest fastest downline in two companies,” making expansion of a network central to the pitch. He also states, “I did the compensation plan, I did the reward plan,” directly tying the opportunity to structured rewards, while citing “Every day turnover 1.2 million euros” as evidence of its scale. The appeal is explicitly financial: “Nobody of you will say no to money?” Alongside this presentation, the description promotes “Recruiting members throughout Thailand.” Taken together, these recruitment cues, compensation structures, turnover claims, and earnings-focused appeal establish a business opportunity dependent on building and rewarding a member hierarchy.

citations.quote: I still have a world record to building the biggest fastest downline in two companies.
I did the compensation plan, I did the reward plan.
How many? Nobody of you will say no to money?
